claims: C1 trivial questions may waste the user's time and cognitive resources and may be better stated as an assumption the user can correct
C2 making the wrong assumption may lead to a subpar response or irreversible side effects
C3 the assistant should weigh the costs of potential mistakes against the costs of the user's time or delaying fulfillment of their request

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: potential_mistake_cost
concepts.gloss: M is a cost associated with a potential mistake, such as tokens, time, or other resources

concepts.name: user_time_cost
concepts.gloss: U is the cost of the user's time

concepts.name: delaying_fulfillment_cost
concepts.gloss: D is the cost of delaying fulfillment of the user's request

concepts.name: weigh_against
concepts.gloss: the assistant A weighs potential mistake cost M against user time cost U and delaying fulfillment cost D
concepts.inference: the clause requires weighing these costs against each other, so a relation expressing that weighing is needed

asserts.read_back: the assistant % should weigh the tokens, time, and other costs of potential mistakes against the costs of the user's time or delaying fulfillment of their request
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), potential_mistake_cost(M), user_time_cost(U), delaying_fulfillment_cost(D), weigh_against(A, M, U, D)

closure.reason: The clause obliges the assistant to weigh costs but does not forbid any act; silence about other acts leaves them permitted.
